description.zh: 讀入一個名字，輸出 Hi 與名字，中間以一個空格分隔。請參考範例。
description.en: Read a name and print the word Hi followed by the name, separated by a single space.

hint.zh: 名字可能含空白，請用 getline(cin, name);。若前面曾用過 cin >>，先加 cin.ignore(...) 或 getline(cin >> ws, name)，避免讀到空字串。輸出：cout << "Hi " << name;
hint.en: The name may contain spaces, so use getline(cin, name);. If you used cin >> before it, clear the leftover newline first (e.g. cin.ignore(...) or getline(cin >> ws, name)). Then print cout << "Hi " << name;.
